# pve_ceph_fs (Resource)

One Ceph filesystem (metadata + data pools), optionally registered as a storage.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "pve_ceph_fs" "example" {
name = "CHANGE_ME"
node = "pve1"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The ceph filesystem name. (default: cephfs)
- `node` (String) The cluster node name.

### Optional

- `add_storage` (Boolean) Configure the created CephFS as storage for this cluster. (default: 0)
- `pg_num` (Number) Number of placement groups for the backing data pool. The metadata pool will use a quarter of this. (default: 128)
- `remove_pools` (Boolean) Remove the metadata and data pools used by this filesystem. (default: 0)
- `remove_storages` (Boolean) Remove pveceph-managed storages configured for this filesystem. (default: 0)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Opaque identifier: node/name (also the `terraform import` format).
